summary: M0 model-only verdict: CONTAIN @ 0.95. Confirmed account takeover for c.aydin@aegean.edu. The user's normal baseline is campus/Manisa (AS-AEGEAN-EDU, Turkcell) with known devices dev-ca-laptop/dev-ca-phone. On 2026-10-08 an unknown device (dev-unk-7f3a) from AS60068 Datacamp Limited in Frankfurt, Germany authenticated: repeated portal failures (22:41-22:44), then an MFA-approved portal login (22:46:12), followed by mail (22:47:30) and repeated SIS accesses (22:51-23:11). Immediately after, a mail forwarding rule was created forwarding to external c.aydin.ogr@proton.me via OWA (22:49:02). Foreign infrastructure, unknown device, MFA approval after failures, mail access, and exfiltration forwarding rule together confirm compromise; contain the account (reset credentials, revoke sessions/devices, remove forwarding rule).
limitations: M0 ablation: Nemotron alone, no tools, no Critic, no Risk Gate, no DQ. Not a product configuration.
